identity: Thunderroot Wilds is the trolls' storm jungle at the Throng's far flank; bog witches bottle its thunder and bandits sell what the storm leaves.

quests.title: An Unhelpful Chorus
quests.text: The Thunder Apes in the {name:canopy}, which lies {zone_area:canopy}, greet every scout with a chorus loud enough to guide an Accord patrol. Hunt them by day and kill four. I asked the spirits for silence; they sent more rain, which was thoughtful but unhelpful.

quests.title: Thunder Needs No Cork
quests.text: The Bottle Witches gather after dark in the {name:bogs}, which lie {zone_area:bogs}, bottling thunder as though the sky were theirs to pickle. Kill four and bring me two Hex Bottle Shards; let us see whose storm they thought they could keep.

quests.title: Rain for the Ashes
quests.text: Our drums carry through rain, but our allies at Ashveil Watch have only the ash wind for company. Find Vaska Ashlistener there on Blackwind Rise and offer your help. Roots hold together beneath the soil; so must the Throng, even where our branches cannot touch.

quests.title: Messages Wrapped in Silk
quests.text: A message wrapped in silk sounds grand until you learn the messenger is still inside. Kill four Funnelwebs after dark in the {name:deepwood}, which lies {zone_area:deepwood}. Our words must reach the other outposts before the spiders finish reading them.

quests.title: Bounty: The Chorus Returns
quests.text: The Thunder Apes have claimed the day's chorus in the {name:deepwood}; even the birds sound offended. Kill six there by day and return for your reward. Wait twenty minutes after collecting before taking this bounty again; that gives me time to remember what a bird sounds like.

quests.title: Listen for the Hiss
quests.text: The marsh speaks to those who listen, but lately our foragers hear nothing except hissing. Kill four Mambas basking by day in the {name:witchmire}, which lies {zone_area:witchmire}. The spirits may teach patience; I would rather our foragers came home to learn it.

quests.title: A Debt at {name:rainchar_camp}
quests.text: The bandits at the {name:rainchar_camp} {dir_from_giver:rainchar_camp} sell our stolen supplies back to us and call the bill a debt, while Thunderstep's fighters make do with scraps. Kill four Brigand Bowmen there; Raincall Basin once had collectors like these, selling farmers their own rain. Hungry fighters hold no line, whatever the spirits promise.

quests.title: Zek Keeps the Wrong Company
quests.text: Bottle-Keeper Zek guards the witches' stolen storms in the {name:stormglades}, {dir_from_giver:bottle_keeper_zek}, with thunder in bottles and apes in the grass. Go by day and kill Zek along with four Thunder Apes in those glades. I want to hear the sky speak with its whole voice again.

quests.title: Party: A Storm Too Many
quests.text: The Bog Witch Storm-Bottle waits in the {name:heartwood}, {dir_from_giver:storm_bottle_witch}, clutching enough stolen thunder to make even the spirits keep their distance. Bring a party and kill her; no one should face that storm alone. Courage is easier to find with friends standing in the rain beside you.

quests.title: Carry the Thunder
quests.text: You came through this jungle listening for danger; now the jungle knows your footsteps. Travel to Tornstandard Hold on Bannerbreak Mesa and report to Yarra Standardmender; she sends Throng fighters on to the front from there. Carry our thunder with you.
